puzzle.hint: The divine greeting of peace and the blessed reward awaiting those who remained patient and steadfast in faith.
puzzle.arabic: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُم بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ ۚ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ
puzzle.verseEn: "Peace [i.e., security] be upon you for what you patiently endured. And excellent is the final home."
